# Woodoo Stadium

> Woodoo is a Danish manufacturer of handbuilt stainless steel foosball tables, built in Copenhagen. Its table, the Stadium 11–11, weighs 150 kg and is made of 100% stainless steel with a bead-blasted finish, built for permanent indoor and outdoor use. Every table comes with a 5-year warranty.

> Woodoo er en dansk producent af håndbyggede bordfodboldborde, bygget i København. Bordfodboldbordet Stadium 11–11 vejer 150 kg og er lavet af 100% rustfrit stål med en glasblæst overflade, bygget til permanent brug både indendørs og udendørs. Hvert bord leveres med 5 års garanti.

## Segments

- Events and companies
- Hotels and hospitality
- Public space and architecture
- Rental and ownership are both available.

## Viewings

Viewings by appointment; no walk-in showroom.
